description: Returns free appointment slots for a given calendar starting from a date. Use slotid from here as input to post_schedule.php.

request_body.date_from: date (YYYY-MM-DD) - search start date, must be in the future

Records.wday: date (YYYY-MM-DD) - a day with available slots

free_timespace.slotid: string - opaque encrypted id, required input to post_schedule.php

notes: Called with calendarid for 'Dr. Ardelean Adina', date_from=2026-09-01 -> returned free slots starting 2026-09-04, so results can skip forward several days past date_from to the next actually-free day.
slotid values are consumed once (booked), so they should be fetched fresh right before use, not cached long-term.
